pretreatment: washed in ethanol followed by Milli Q water and dried with a nitrogen jet
surface_functionalization: hydroxylation step by water plasma and functionalization with perﬂuorodecyldimethylchlorosilane (PFDS)
evidence: Prior to ALD, membranes were repeatedly washed in ethanol followed by Milli Q water and dried with a nitrogen jet. The surfaces of the SiO2/AAO membranes were hydroxylated under water plasma at a pressure of 0.2 atm for 1 min. The water plasma process forms OH groups over both SiO2 and alumina surfaces. The samples were then functionalized with the hydrophobic silane, perﬂuorodecyldimethylchlorosilane (PFDS) by immersion in a 0.1 v% solution of the silane in dry toluene for 2 h under N2 atmosphere.
